g.title: init
g.text: resolve normal config + managed CLI path

g.title: optional
g.text: TTY confirmation or --yes for repo creation
named GitHub user requires explicit URL

g.title: partial
g.text: Stage failure: nonzero error / retained backup
earlier successful stages may remain; no cross-host rollback
publish optional setup warning differs from sync setup failure

g.title: claude
g.text: Claude MCP failure throws before later host stages

g.title: consent
g.text: no feature override or hooks write

g.title: blocked
g.text: not a rollback of unrelated host settings

g.title: skipped
g.text: Skipped / dry-run is not a completed write
MCP stage remains separate from native hook consent

g.title: mcp
g.text: Codex / Grok / Cursor MCP loop, when available
preserve other servers / env / timeouts / disabled

g.title: result
g.text: client restart / use is a separate action

g.title: diag
g.text: Git local status + cached counts + failure state
live remote read; no fetch or repair

g.title: status
g.text: Cursor / Grok required only when requested
